notes.note: #0.147-161 is a 15-slot leader block; 0565's Pt_Chara_Check chain is OOO, W, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, Nu, Zero, Zeta, Mebius, Seven, Ultraman, Taro, God, Wing Zero, 00, and the wording matches it (slot 3 = Momotaros, slot 9 = polite with -san = Mebius). So #0.155 = Mebius (polite), #0.156-161 = Seven, Ultraman, Taro, God, Wing Zero, 00. Story_098 holds slots 1-8 of the same block; align the plain line if it chose differently.
Core Medal names romanized Ebi / Kani / Sasori (Shrimp / Crab / Scorpion), following story_097's romanized Kujaku / Condor / Taka. Not in glossary.
Ankh's line: the medals Ikadevil took from the Armored Samurai Kaijin (glossary name).

Labelled Ankh by the extractor, but the script runs Pt_Chara_Check(10) (00) and sets both CHARA_NAME 10 and 36 around #0.3/#0.4: #0.3 is most likely 00 recognizing the term, #0.4 Ankh's version if 00 is absent. Both written to fit their likely speaker.
Door sign: deliberate two-line layout kept with a line break.
#0.10 plays when 00 is in the party (Pt_Chara_Check(10)); #0.11 is the alternate greeting. Ali's voice kept from earlier slices ('the 00 brat', 'ya').

0566 leader chain: 00, Wing Zero, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, OOO, W, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, Ultraman, God, God (dup in script; Seven absent), Taro. Matches wording: slot 9 (#0.23, #0.41) is Momotaros (rough; forgets the term 'GN Drive Tau'), slots 6-8 (#0.20-22, Mebius/OOO/W) use the milder pronoun -> 'You there!' vs 'You!' for the harsher one.
Momotaros garbles the term (source: 'pseudo-whatsit'); rendered 'GN Drive whatchamacallit'.
Compressed slightly for the box ('Not part of my job' for 'even if it's outside my mission').
Labelled Taro by the extractor (CHARA_NAME 13), but the replay also shows CHARA_NAME 13 on the computed leader lines, so this may really be the party leader. Wording kept neutral.
'Taisho' = 'the boss' as in story slices for 0256; who the boss is stays unspecified, as in the source.
Spoken after the Virgo battle; 'bakeru' = could become something formidable.

report: 80/80 rows translated. Leader blocks voiced by each script's Pt_Chara_Check chain (matches wording). Uncertain: #0566.3 speaker likely 00 not Ankh; #0566.68 speaker may be party leader not Taro; Ebi/Kani/Sasori romanized (not in glossary).
